glossary.definition: (A) "County department of job and family services" means the county department of job and family services established under this section, including an entity designated a county department of job and family services under section 307.981 of the Revised Code, or a joint county department of job and family services established under section 329.40 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: county department of job and family services
glossary.scope: As used in the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 329.01 - County department of job and family services - director, assistants, bonds.
glossary.term: County department of job and family services

glossary.definition: (B) "County director of job and family services" means the county director of job and family services appointed under this section or under section 329.41 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: county director of job and family services
